evidence: The original resource note at source line 463 and the Stage-1 resource record use the malformed host www.gtn-g-ch. Atlas paper 156 gives the GlaThiDa data location as https://www.gtn-g.ch/data_catalogue_glathida/, and the live official GTN-G page at that URL identifies Glacier Thickness Database (GlaThiDa) 3.1.0. The intended resource identity is therefore unambiguous.
